objective: Diagnose whether the frozen rotation-invariant cycle grades conceal stable current-state-oriented route effects, without refitting any detector, structural model, quality model, threshold, calibration, or probability.

diagnostic_unit.definition: A frozen cycle occurrence evaluated only at anchors whose causal current state equals current_state.
diagnostic_unit.exact_route: Report the unique oriented closed path when the current state identifies exactly one deduplicated rotation.
diagnostic_unit.ambiguous_route: If one current state admits multiple distinct rotations, retain their union exactly as stored and label route_kind=ambiguous_union; do not infer the hidden route.

periods.2023: already-opened backward portability score using future-fitted 2024 structure

outcomes_and_probabilities.thresholds: exactly the frozen parent-contract global 2024 P75 and P90 thresholds

route_support_and_gates.support: Apply the parent per-cycle OOF and scoring-period support counts unchanged to each oriented route.
route_support_and_gates.endpoint_support: Apply the parent P75 and P90 positive/negative counts unchanged to each route, target, and horizon.
route_support_and_gates.conditional_proper_loss: Apply parent qcycle-versus-qcontext log-loss, Brier, daily upper-bound, quarter, stock-deletion, and calibration gates.
route_support_and_gates.joint_chain: Apply parent s*qcycle-versus-s*qcontext gates on every compatible row for the oriented route.
route_support_and_gates.incremental_lift: Apply the parent observed-rate/qcontext ratio and five-session residual lower-bound gates.
route_support_and_gates.structural: Apply the parent history-path-versus-first-order loss and calibration gates separately within each route; required for 2025 and 2023 grades as in the parent contract.
route_support_and_gates.high_and_good_rates: Apply the parent raw P75/P90 and mean-qcycle thresholds unchanged.

diagnostic_labels.meaning: Post-outcome descriptive labels only; none is a certified quality tier or permission to enter either shadow.

cross_period_logic.horizon_grade: minimum diagnostic label across 2024 OOF, 2025, and backward-2023
cross_period_logic.global_grade: minimum across all three horizons and all three periods
cross_period_logic.permitted_use: Generate bounded hypotheses for a separately frozen nested-2024 V2 experiment.
